name: snaffle
install:
set -euo pipefail
UV=/usr/local/bin/uv
if [ ! -x "$UV" ] || [ "$("$UV" --version | awk '{print $2}')" != "0.12.17" ]; then
  tmp="$(mktemp)"
  curl -LsSf -o "$tmp" https://astral.sh/uv/0.12.17/install.sh
  sudo UV_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh "$tmp"
  rm -f "$tmp"
fi
if ! command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq unzip
fi
"$UV" sync --locked --group dev --extra speedups
